reasons: Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) expensive

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.71% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +5bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+1.3pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 149 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 102 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 17.7 sits at the 59th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 8.5, so implied carries +9.2 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Oracle reports Q1 FY2027 results tonight as it seeks up to $40B in debt and equity for AI buildout
items.note: Oracle prints fiscal Q1 results after the close with its CDS already elevated and a Scotiabank price-target trim ahead of print; the company has flagged plans to raise ~$40B this fiscal year via debt and equity, underscoring how far capex has outrun operating cash flow and its concentration risk to OpenAI. Pre-event positioning, not yet a realized outcome.

items.headline: SoftBank confirms early payoff of $25.9B OpenAI bridge loan, launches $10-20B junk-bond roadshow
items.note: SoftBank must retire the $25.9B outstanding balance on its $40B OpenAI-investment bridge loan by Sept 15 and is meeting investors Sept 14-17 to test demand for a $10-20B BB+-rated dollar/euro junk-bond sale — a concrete sign the OpenAI bet is being pushed onto high-yield markets rather than absorbed on balance sheet.

items.headline: Hyperscalers rush $50-60B of bonds to market post-Labor Day as rising yields squeeze AI debt pipeline
items.note: Bankers expect a record wave of hyperscaler bond supply immediately after Labor Day, with some issuers pulling sales forward to get ahead of further yield increases — a sign AI-linked issuers see financing conditions as more likely to worsen than improve from here.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
